name: Workato
tagline: Workato is an enterprise automation platform that connects apps and automates complex business workflows without code. Its AI features include a natural language recipe builder, intelligent document processing, and AI-powered bots. Over 17,000 enterprises use Workato to automate processes across HR, finance, and IT.
